Dear Miss Yonge
Yesterday [Mr Craik](/person/379) paid [£200](/topic/160) into [Hoare’s](/organisation/169) in your a/c. [I](/person/939) hope my not telling you before will have caused you no [illegible]
I am very sorry you do not like the [illustrations](/topic/167).[^1] It is now impossible to get fresh ones done, and pardon me saying I really like them. I hope you will get reconciled to them by and by
[Rest of letter indecipherable as is the one, dated 22 January 1868, that follows]


[^1]: These were presumably [Edward Armitage](/person/60)\'s illustrations for [The Pupils of St.

John the Divine](/book/72) in Macmillan\'s [Sunday Library](/topic/145) series.
